verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS ATS like Lever, but nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting to disable telemetry, usage tracking, or analytics collection. The cross-customer benchmarking claim describes aggregated insights, not a user-controllable opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
